name: LockBit
description: LockBit is a Russian ransomware-as-a-service group that first surfaced in September 2019 and became the world's most prolific ransomware operation by 2022. The group claimed more than 2,000 victims worldwide and extorted over $120 million in payments. LockBit was dismantled in February 2024 by 'Operation Cronos' — a multinational law enforcement action that seized 34 servers, arrested two members in Poland and Ukraine, and offered free decryption tools to victims.

sources.title: Feds Seize LockBit Ransomware Websites, Offer Decryption Tools — Krebs on Security
